work.name: Laikon Biotech
work.summary: Developed LLM application infrastructure for domain-specific data processing, fine-tuning, and evaluation workflows.
highlights: Built a data governance pipeline to support structured LLM application development workflows.
Fine-tuned Qwen3-8B with QLoRA, reducing VRAM usage by 74% while preserving domain adaptation capability.
Developed an evaluation framework for generated outputs, reaching BERTScore 0.6812.

work.name: CitiXP

Unified OAuth authentication flows and supported production app release workflows.
Migrated CDN infrastructure, reducing cost by 65%, TTFB by 30%, and LCP by 20%.

projects.name: FinGraphRAG
projects.description: Portfolio Risk & Market Analysis using GraphRAG with Qdrant + Neo4j
projects.summary: Full-stack portfolio risk and market analysis prototype using HybridRAG with Qdrant vector search and Neo4j knowledge graphs.
highlights: Modeled financial relationships that are difficult for traditional RAG to capture through single-hop retrieval.
Built a data pipeline for SEC filings, portfolio data, and news events with automated chunking plus vector and graph indexing.
Implemented query orchestration across semantic search, graph expansion, and exposure calculation.
Delivered a containerized prototype with streaming queries using Python, FastAPI, React, Qdrant, Neo4j, and Docker Compose.

projects.name: LLM Agent & Tool-Enhanced Reasoning
projects.description: Multi-task reasoning framework with reranking, self-reflection, and MCP tool calls
projects.summary: Reasoning framework for graph shortest path, MMLU-Medicine QA, and InfoBench information extraction with reranking, self-reflection, and ReAct-style tool calls.
highlights: Implemented 50-candidate reranking with log-probability, reward model, PairRM, MBR, and related scoring mechanisms.
Built a four-step self-reflection workflow with draft generation followed by three optimization rounds.
Integrated ReAct-style MCP tool calls for external verification and tool-enhanced reasoning.
Deployed an OpenAI Completions API-compatible service on dual A100 80GB GPUs for up to 300 concurrent requests using Python, PyTorch, Transformers, and Qwen3.
